title: 3D QMY Coins, Luxury Home Page, Scroll-to-Title, Remove Caffeine References

requirements.text: Replace the existing floating coin image animations on the Home page (HomePage.tsx) with fully 3D rendered QMY coins using React Three Fiber / Three.js. Each coin must be a realistic disc/coin shape with 'QMY' embossed or inscribed on its face, a gold metallic material with specular highlights, and float/drift smoothly and gently across the space background with subtle rotation. Remove all or CSS-based coin image elements used for the floating coins.

quotes: Quero remover essas moedas flutuantes, essas moedas são imagens e eu não quero imagens, eu quero as moedas em 3D, em formato de moeda verdadeira QMY, moeda em formato coin 3D a flutuar suavemente pelo universo

acceptanceCriteria: No tags or CSS background-image rules are used for the floating coins on the Home page
At least 5 QMY coins are rendered as 3D disc/coin meshes using React Three Fiber with a gold metallic PBR material
'QMY' text or embossed lettering is visible on the coin face
Coins float and drift smoothly across the space background with gentle rotation animations
The Three.js canvas overlays the existing SpaceBackground without breaking the rest of the page layout

requirements.text: Redesign the Home page (HomePage.tsx) to have a luxury aesthetic. Apply rich gold, deep black, and champagne color palettes, elegant serif typography (Cinzel already available), glass-morphism or dark velvet card surfaces, subtle gold glow effects on key elements, and refined spacing. The overall feel must evoke high-end exclusivity consistent with a luxury financial/token brand.

quotes: a página inicial quero a página com aspecto Luxury

acceptanceCriteria: Home page uses a dark luxury color palette (deep blacks, rich golds, champagne accents) throughout
Headings use the Cinzel serif font with gold color
Section cards or panels use glass-morphism or dark velvet surfaces with gold border accents
Gold glow/shimmer effects are applied to primary CTA buttons and key headings
Overall visual impression is premium and elegant, not generic or playful

requirements.text: On the Home page (HomePage.tsx), implement a scroll-down behavior on initial load so the page automatically scrolls downward slightly to reveal the main page title/hero heading. The very top of the page (above the title) should scroll out of view on load, making the title the first prominent visible element, while still allowing the user to scroll back up.

quotes: quero que a página desça para que o topo e título da página de entrada fique visível

acceptanceCriteria: On initial page load, the Home page auto-scrolls so the main hero title is at or near the top of the viewport
Any content above the title (e.g. a spacer or pre-hero element) is scrolled out of view automatically
The user can scroll back up to see content above the title
The scroll behavior is smooth, not instant/jarring

requirements.text: Remove all references to 'Caffeine' from the Footer component (Footer.tsx), Layout.tsx, and any other frontend files where the word 'Caffeine' appears as visible text, branding, or attribution. Replace or remove those references entirely so no end-user-facing text mentions Caffeine.

quotes: não quero referências à Caffeine nem palavras Caffeine nos rodapés

acceptanceCriteria: The Footer component contains no visible 'Caffeine' text or branding
No other rendered page or component shows the word 'Caffeine' to end users
Any 'Powered by' or attribution lines that referenced Caffeine are removed or replaced with a neutral/Quantumoney attribution

constraints: Do not modify any files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
Do not change any pages or components other than HomePage.tsx, Footer.tsx, Layout.tsx, and the new 3D coin component
Do not alter the backend in any way
The SpaceBackground component must remain intact; the 3D coin canvas should layer on top of it
nonGoals: Redesigning any page other than the Home page
Adding new backend features or modifying data models
Changing the Header navigation or any other layout components beyond removing Caffeine references
Adding real-time or interactive coin click functionality
Modifying the AR game pages or profile pages
